**A civilian is killed and another is critically injured during clashes between [[Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades|Al-Qassam Brigades]]' supporters and [[Palestinian Security Services|Palestinian authorities]] outside a police station in [[Nablus]], in the occupied [[West Bank]], following the arrest of two militants. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/suspect-in-terror-killing-of-woman-84-found-dead-after-apparent-suicide/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Tigray War]]
**[[Tigray People's Liberation Front]] authorities say that [[Eritrea]] has launched a full-scale intervention into the [[Tigray Region]] of [[Ethiopia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tigrayan-forces-ethiopia-say-eritrea-launches-full-scale-offensive-2022-09-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[National Bank of Georgia]] formally applies to join the [[European Union]]'s [[Single Euro Payments Area]]. [https://agenda.ge/en/news/2022/3615 (Agenda)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**Four people are killed and 114 others are injured as [[Typhoon Nanmadol (2022)|Typhoon Nanmadol]] makes landfall on the island of [[Kyushu]], [[Japan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62873980 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 Pakistan floods]]
**Nine people have died of [[diarrhea]], [[malaria]] and [[gastroenteritis]] during the last 24 hours in [[Sindh|Sindh Province]], [[Pakistan]], thereby bringing the nationwide death toll from flooding to more than 1,600 people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/20/people-dying-of-water-borne-diseases-in-flood-hit-pakistan (Al Jazeera)]
*Eight people are injured after an explosion tore through a building in [[Austin, Chicago|Austin]], [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/explosions-chicago-bureau-of-alcohol-tobacco-firearms-and-explosives-building-c1895041d37132198a0ddf5b465f63ef (AP)]
*Nine people are killed and 31 others are injured after a [[concrete slab]] collapsed on top of the auditorium bleachers during a political event in [[Itapecerica da Serra]], [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.latinpost.com/articles/156820/20220921/brazil-dead-injured-concrete-slab-collapsed-campaign-event.htm (Latin Post)]

*****[[Mayor of New York City|New York City Mayor]] [[Eric Adams]] announces that [[New York City|the city]] will end its [[COVID-19 vaccine]] mandate for private businesses on November 1. [https://www.axios.com/2022/09/20/nyc-ends-vaccine-mandate-private-businesses (Axios)]
